description: Derived from AGSC-03-26: a `supersedes` target whose status is `stable`, authored or by default (AGSC-02-23), is the warning AGSC-E316, carried by the item that authors the `supersedes`. `n1` supersedes `o1`, which authors no status and so is stable by default; `n2` supersedes `o2`, which authors `status: stable`. Two findings. The warning changes neither item: the hiding step of composition is unchanged. The hub item gives `n1` and `n2` an inbound link.
